acceptance: Owner decides whether scripts/site_inputs.py should consume a pinned published-results archive commit or whether published-only Explorer ingestion in adr-independent-publication-authorities.md and adr-published-results-slim-corpus-branch.md is formally superseded.
Code and ADRs match the settled owner decision with no silent contradiction.
context: Surfaced during ADR reconciliation on 2026-11-24: adr-site-repo-split.md D12 retired the publication manifest control plane, and scripts/site_inputs.py builds the Explorer site-inputs bundle from results-data/ on develop, whereas adr-published-results-slim-corpus-branch.md and adr-independent-publication-authorities.md still name published-results as the complete accepted archive.
description:
## Problem
`docs/internal/adr/adr-published-results-slim-corpus-branch.md` and `docs/internal/adr/adr-independent-publication-authorities.md` name `published-results` as the complete accepted Phase 2 archive whose validator-clean results feed the Explorer. However, `adr-site-repo-split.md` D12 retired the legacy publication manifest control plane, and `scripts/site_inputs.py` currently builds the attested Explorer site-inputs bundle exclusively from `results-data/` on `develop`. Any bundle accepted only on `published-results` is therefore omitted from the deployed Explorer.

## Change
Present the tradeoff to the owner and either (a) extend `scripts/site_inputs.py` to consume a pinned `published-results` commit, or (b) formally supersede published-only Explorer ingestion in the ADRs and update the contributor guide accordingly.
